WORK_ON_ISSUES.name: Work On Issues
WORK_ON_ISSUES.description: Ability to log work done against an issue. Only useful if Time Tracking is turned on.

CREATE_ATTACHMENTS.name: Create Attachments
CREATE_ATTACHMENTS.description: Users with this permission may create attachments.

LINK_ISSUES.name: Link Issues
LINK_ISSUES.description: Ability to link issues together and create linked issues. Only useful if issue linking is turned on.

BROWSE_PROJECTS.name: Browse Projects
BROWSE_PROJECTS.description: Ability to browse projects and the issues within them.

ADMINISTER.name: Jira Administrators
ADMINISTER.description: Ability to perform most administration functions (excluding Import & Export, SMTP Configuration, etc.).

ARCHIVE_ISSUES.name: Archive Issues
ARCHIVE_ISSUES.description: Ability to archive issues for a specific project.
